reviewMethod: manual visual inspection; source and pose hash binding only

entries.identityNote: The petite build is modestly compact. Rear seated clipboard was corrected to a low right-lap edge; standing identity and outfit remain consistent.

poses.observation: Clipboard is upright at the inspector's own right-front waist, on screen-left; right hand grips the same board edge. Cream paper, tan rim and metal clip are visible.
Clipboard stays at the near anatomical right side in front of the waist; right forearm and grip are visible. Direction was generated rather than mirrored.
Clipboard stays at the far anatomical right side, with a leading tan/cream edge visible in front of the torso. The right forearm is partly occluded by the body; no side swap is visible.
Clipboard stays on the inspector's own right, on screen-right. The rear torso occludes most of the paper and board; the exposed edge and bent right elbow are coherent.
Clipboard lies across the own-right lap/thigh on screen-left under the right hand. The other hand may rest beside or support the board; it is not an upright carried board.
Clipboard lies on the lap below the near right hand and forearm. Board/paper edges remain visible and do not determine the authored seat contact.

Clipboard lies on the far right lap with a visible low board or paper edge. The near left hand/forearm may overlap it; the far right grip is partly hidden and requires manager assessment at game scale.

Clipboard is low on the right lap rather than carried upright. The rear torso and right forearm occlude nearly all of it; only a small tan/cream edge is visible on screen-right. The visible sliver can be hard to read at game scale.

limitations: Rear seated clipboards are deliberately mostly occluded. Nine initial sheets had an upright rear clipboard and received built-in targeted edits; 009 already had a lap-level board. Final rear views expose only a thin right-side edge, so clipboard recognition at game scale remains a manager visual acceptance question.

In seated W views the clipboard is on the far right lap. The near left hand often overlaps the board, so the far right support/grip cannot be independently proven from visible pixels alone. The board edge is especially subtle for 004 and 006. 008 received a second targeted edit to expose a clear flat tan/cream lap board in W.
